Sự Can Thiệp Trái Phép

An act of unlawful seizure, threat or attack against an aircraft, its passengers, crew or ground infrastructure that endangers aviation safety.

What is Sự Can Thiệp Trái Phép?

In this glossary, Sự Can Thiệp Trái Phép refers to: An act of unlawful seizure, threat or attack against an aircraft, its passengers, crew or ground infrastructure that endangers aviation safety.
